patterns.note: Content is presented within a generous, centered container with ample whitespace, creating a highly airy and minimal presentation.
A sophisticated serif font is used for primary statements and headings, contrasted with a clean, understated sans-serif for navigation, body text, and client names.
The site uses a dominant warm off-white background paired with deep charcoal text, creating a soft yet authoritative visual contrast.

The main hero statement scrolls out of view as the user scrolls down, allowing the client logo grid to smoothly transition into the primary visual focus, while the header navigation remains fixed at the top.

The page structure moves from a large, impactful textual statement, to a grid of established client logos, and then to a large, abstract architectural image, building a sense of gravitas and portfolio strength.

technique_notes: The overall page layout utilizes a centered content wrapper with significant horizontal and vertical padding, ensuring a spacious and uncluttered aesthetic.
The header navigation is implemented as a sticky element, fixing it to the top of the viewport so it remains accessible throughout the user's scroll.

The hero section's primary text content is designed to scroll off-screen, allowing the subsequent client portfolio section to naturally ascend and become the main focal point as the user scrolls down the page.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, elegant serif hero text (~3-4x body) with smaller, clean sans-serif for navigation and body text.
design_tokens.spacing: very airy, especially in the hero section and around content blocks, contributing to a minimal and sophisticated feel

standout: The site's distinctive blend of classical architectural imagery with a highly minimal, spacious layout and elegant typography creates a unique sense of established authority and timelessness, diverging from typical modern tech aesthetics. The deliberate design choice to let the hero statement scroll away to reveal the client portfolio emphasizes substance and a curated approach.
